title: SICNU GEO RS LabSpec
description: Declarative specification of an undergraduate remote-sensing lab exercise. One file drives the guided workflow UI, headless execution (operator_id + params), auto-grading (grading_ref / grading_rules) and generated documentation (scripts/gen_lab_docs.py). LabSpec 2 (spec_version 2, lab platform 12.0) is a strict superset of v1: it adds structured Chinese teaching content (objective_zh, glossary), expected artifacts, pedagogical parameter allow-ranges and an explicit grading_rules pointer. The C++ loader (src/app/widgets/lab_spec_loader.cpp) is authoritative; it accepts 1 and 2 and rejects v2-only keys in v1 documents. Authoring guide: docs/labs/LABSPEC.md.

spec_version.description: LabSpec contract version; 2 is the strict superset (see ADR 0146 and docs/labs/LABSPEC.md).

id.description: Canonical lab id; must equal the file name stem (<id>.lab.json). Zero-padded labNN keeps listings and generated docs in a stable order.

objective.description: Teaching objective, shown as the lab description in the guided workflow list.

prerequisites.description: Data the student must load before stepping through the lab (paths relative to the project root).

pipeline.description: Path (project-root relative) to the pipeline JSON used for auto-grading, e.g. data/pipelines/landsat_ndvi.json.

grading_ref.description: Optional; consumed by D4/D7 auto-grading. Drift-guarded: the referenced file must exist.

thinking_questions.description: Open questions printed in the generated lab document.

objective_zh.description: Chinese teaching objective (中文教学目标); v2 only.

glossary.description: Bilingual terms the lab introduces; v2 only.

path.description: Project-root-relative output the student must produce (outputs/...).

expected_artifacts.description: Artifacts a completed lab must contain; drift-guarded by tests; v2 only.

param_ranges.description: Pedagogical parameter allow-ranges per operator (the Processing Registry remains the runtime authority); min<=max is validated by the loader; v2 only.

grading_rules.description: Path (project-root relative) to the sicnu.lab.rules/1 grading rules file, e.g. data/labs/grading/ndvi_basics.rules.json — the file the `lab --lab <id> --grade` seam actually reads; v2 only.

principles.description: Structured theory blocks (heading/body/formulas) rendered into the generated lab document; v2 only.

prerequisite_knowledge.description: Prior labs/concepts the student needs, as free strings — prerequisites[] remains the data-ref list; v2 only.

description_zh.description: Chinese step instructions (中文说明), the teaching body of the step.

operator_id.description: Processing Registry operator this step launches/executes; must resolve in the registry and params must match the operator schema.

params.description: Operator parameters (JobRequest.params); requires operator_id. Keys are drift-guarded against the operator descriptor's input ports.

action.description: UI-verb slot on the main window (Q_INVOKABLE/public slot) for steps with no operator, e.g. addRasterLayer. Mutually exclusive with operator_id.

teaching_note.description: Background theory the student should take away (printed in docs, shown as hint).

completion_hint.description: How the student knows the step is done.
